ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails behind recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Somali fraud investigation and the child care spending scandal.
questions: What are the financial connections between the different fraud cases?
How are the perpetrators laundering their money?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger network of fraud and corruption in the state.
